draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 73rd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 7th of 26 at LB. He lasted until pick 119, well after his grade rank (73rd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Christian Harris. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (10th percentile), broad jump (10th percentile). College production: 82 tackles in 2024, 12th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals. 17 career games and 12 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 5 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: combined tackles 106 (80th percentile), passes defended 4 (78th percentile). Weak spots: passer rating allowed 115.8 (10th percentile), missed tackle rate 13.8% (11th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 off-ball linebacker who played: 106 combined tackles against a median of 23, above the norm.
